slides.texte_overlay:
5 signs someone secretly wants
your attention number 3
never fails

1. they notice small changes

we only notice tiny changes in people we already watch closely. a new haircut, a different jacket, a shift in your mood, and they're the first to spot it.

2. fast replies, then silence

they answer instantly and then go quiet. it isn't coldness, they simply caught themselves caring a little more than they were ever ready to show you openly.

3. they mention your name

if they talk about you when you're not around, you're on their mind. we mostly mention the people we think about, which is exactly why this sign never fails.

4. the quiet watcher

they watch every story you post but never react. watching without showing it is often the clearest sign of attention someone is trying very hard to hide.

5. surprising topics

when your conversations drift far from small talk, their attention stays. people want more time with someone who always has a surprising story to tell.
